package control_flow_graph

import "fmt"

func AdamicNewBlockTrace(counts []int) {
	for _, count := range counts {
		builder := Builder[string]{}
		for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
			block := builder.newBlock()
			fresh := index == 0 || block != builder.blocks[index-1]
			fmt.Printf("%d,%d,%d,%d,%t,%d,%d,%t,%t,%t,%t,%t,%d\n", count, block.index, len(builder.blocks), len(builder.blockChunks), block.Reachable, len(block.Events), len(block.Successors), builder.blocks[index] == block, fresh, block.hasIncoming, block.final, block.thrown, len(block.cycleBarrier))
			block.Events = append(block.Events, fmt.Sprintf("event-%d", index))
		}
		for _, block := range builder.blocks {
			fmt.Printf("stored,%d,%s\n", block.index, block.Events[0])
		}
	}
}
